subject: Invoice collection plan + VAT breakdown for renewal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: procurement@brightleaf.com, Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightleaf.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-09T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Invoice collection plan + VAT breakdown for renewal

Hi Amir / Brightleaf procurement team,

Following our renewal signature last week I’m circulating the invoicing package and a proposed collection plan so we can close the balance and finalize the activation schedule. Attached: invoice_renewal_8342.pdf (final renewal invoice) and VAT_calculation_2026.xlsx (VAT split and reclaim guidance).

Summary:
- Total due: EUR 198,400 (includes prorated compute true-up).
- VATable portion: EUR 18,400 (shown in the attached calc).
- Proposed payment: 50% on receipt (EUR 99,200), remaining 50% within 30 days of go-live.

Questions for you:
1) Do you want the invoice issued to Brightleaf Health Ltd (UK) or to your EU operating entity (Brightleaf Ireland)? If to Ireland, please provide VAT registration number so we can zero-rate appropriately.
2) Which payment method do you prefer: wire (we'll provide IBAN) or Bill.com link?
3) Please confirm PO number to add to the invoice.

Next steps: if we get confirmation today we’ll send a DocuSign amendment (small billing addendum) and enable the renewal in our provisioning system.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so Finance can book this in the same cycle.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 617-555-0123

Attachments:
- invoice_renewal_8342.pdf (PDF, 1 page invoice)
- VAT_calculation_2026.xlsx (XLSX, VAT line-item breakout)

From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightleaf.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, procurement@brightleaf.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-09T11:02:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice collection plan + VAT breakdown for renewal

Thanks Jonas — received. A few quick items from our side: 

- We’d prefer the invoice to be issued to Brightleaf Ireland if possible; that will let us apply the reverse-charge mechanism and avoid domestic VAT. 
- To proceed we need Redwood’s confirmation that you are able to invoice non-UK/EU entity (Brightleaf Ireland), and we’ll send our VAT registration number once I have Procurement confirm.
- Also please confirm the legal company name and tax ID you’ll put on the invoice for cross-border wire. 

FYI, procurement@brightleaf.com is looping in our AP team — they will ask for the final invoice to be sent to invoices@brightleaf.com for processing. If you have a DocuSign amendment link for the billed entity change, send it over and I’ll route it for signature.

Appreciate the proposed schedule; I’ll expedite on our side once we get the VAT guidance.

—Amir
Amir Patel
CFO, Brightleaf Health
amir.patel@brightleaf.com

Hi all — Laura from Redwood Finance here. Quick clarifications and required docs to move the invoice to the Brightleaf Ireland entity: 

1) We can re-issue to Brightleaf Ireland and apply reverse-charge mechanics, but we need Brightleaf’s EU VAT number and a signed confirmation that the Irish entity will be the contracting party.
2) For wire payments please use the IBAN below (also in payment_instructions.txt attached):
   - Account name: Redwood Inference Inc.
   - IBAN: GB12REDW00000012345678
   - SWIFT: REDWGB2L
3) The total on the provided invoice includes a prorated true-up for overages (line: compute true-up EUR 34,800). If you prefer we can split that out to a separate interim invoice — confirm if you want single invoice or two documents.
4) Please provide PO number and copy of your VAT registration (we’ll attach to our tax file).

I’ve attached Brightleaf_tax_forms_request.pdf which lists the items we need to reissue the invoice to your Irish entity. Also attaching payment_instructions.txt with the wire reference to include (Ref: DL-8342).

If you confirm the VAT number and PO by EOD tomorrow we’ll send the final invoice and DocuSign amendment (Amendment_SOW_8342.docx) to the signatories.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments:
- Brightleaf_tax_forms_request.pdf (PDF)
- payment_instructions.txt (TXT)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@brightleaf.com>, procurement@brightleaf.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-11T10:21:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice collection plan + VAT breakdown for renewal

Amir / team — circling back with a concrete plan so AP can process: 

Plan we’ll execute once you confirm VAT number and PO: 
- Issue final invoice to Brightleaf Ireland with reverse-charge line and VAT note.
- Send DocuSign amendment (short SOW addendum) — link below — for your signature to switch billed entity.
- Provide either Bill.com payment link (preferred for card/ACH) or wire instructions (IBAN above).

Proposed payment schedule (still flexible if you need):
- 50% on receipt of invoice (EUR 99,200) — Redwood enables renewal routing upon payment.
- Remaining 50% within 30 days of go-live / activation.

DocuSign: https://redwood.app/docusign/DL-8342-amend
Bill.com pay: https://app.bill.com/pay/REDWOOD-8342 (note: if you choose Bill.com we’ll email the payer link directly to invoices@brightleaf.com)

Attachment: Amendment_SOW_8342.docx (1 page, proposed billing addendum).

If you confirm now we’ll issue the invoice with the exact wire descriptors and VAT breakdown before end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Jonas

Amir
